request.spec:
Live due now rounds half to even (1.025 becomes 1.02, 1.035 becomes 1.04). A settled claim keeps
its frozen figure. Every due-total is now the sum of the already-rounded claim figures, not the
rounded total amount times the rate; a person with nothing that counts shows 0.00. A person whose
grade has no rate today still shows n/a even with nothing that counts (n/a wins over 0.00), unless
a settled claim keeps a figure: then the total is the sum of the figures there are. The sheet's
due-total is still everyone's due-total added up.
request.prompt:

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Live due now rounds half to even (1.025 becomes 1.02, 1.035 becomes 1.04). A settled claim keeps
its frozen figure. Every due-total is now the sum of the already-rounded claim figures, not the
rounded total amount times the rate; a person with nothing that counts shows 0.00. A person whose
grade has no rate today still shows n/a even with nothing that counts (n/a wins over 0.00), unless

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is in and all 4 tests in the acceptance spec pass under `bin/e2e`.

- **Rounding:** live due now rounds half to even in the front end (`src/main/frontend/features/rates/due.ts`). The server's figure for settling a claim (`Rates.due` in `Rates.java`) now uses half-to-even as well, so a newly settled claim freezes the same figure that was shown live. Claims settled earlier keep the figures already stored; no data is migrated.
- **Due-totals:** a new `dueTotal` in `due.ts` adds up the already-rounded figures of a person's open and settled claims. A settled claim uses its frozen figure; a live one is worked out at the rate in force on the claim's own date.
  - With nothing that counts, the total is 0.00.
  - If the person's grade has no rate today, the total is n/a, unless a settled claim keeps a figure; then it is the sum of the figures there are.
  - A claim whose own figure is n/a adds nothing to the total.
- **Sheet total:** `PeopleList.tsx` uses the same calculation per person, and the sheet's due-total is still those totals added up, skipping n/a.

**Behaviour change:** each person's total now uses each claim's own rate, not their grade's rate on the sheet's today. So when a rate changes over time, it can differ from the old total.
